decisions.summary: 威世智在MagicCon Atlanta预览活动中展示了《万智牌》2027年首个系列《沉没之境瑙克提斯》的部分新卡，并确认该系列将于2027年2月5日推出；本场没有公布尚未揭晓的两个Universes Beyond联动系列。

decisions.reason: 正式预览活动带来新卡与明确发售日，且澄清本场没有两个待公布联动系列的信息，具有直接信息增量。

decisions.headline: PS5基础版QSSR支持扩展至六款游戏
decisions.summary: 索尼确认《漫威蜘蛛侠2》《Control Resonant》《Arc Raiders》《The Finals》《无人深空》和《Hell Let Loose: Vietnam》将支持PS5基础版QSSR；其中《漫威蜘蛛侠2》更新已上线，《Control Resonant》计划12月更新，其余作品时间尚未全部公布。

entries.headline: MagicCon Atlanta reveals new Nauctis: The Sunken Realm cards
entries.summary: Wizards of the Coast showed several new cards from Magic: The Gathering—Nauctis: The Sunken Realm at MagicCon Atlanta and confirmed a February 5, 2027 release. The panel did not reveal the two still-unannounced Universes Beyond sets.
entries.verification: The opened IGN liveblog records the Wizards of the Coast panel, the cards shown, the release date, and the absence of announcements for the other crossover sets.
entries.timeNote: Published at 02:14 Beijing time on November 14, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Base PS5 QSSR support expands to six games
entries.summary: Sony says Marvel's Spider-Man 2, Control Resonant, Arc Raiders, The Finals, No Man's Sky, and Hell Let Loose: Vietnam will support QSSR on base PS5 consoles. Spider-Man 2's update is live, Control Resonant is due in December, and several other dates remain unannounced.
entries.verification: The opened IGN report relays the PlayStation Blog announcement and identifies all six games plus the disclosed timing.
entries.timeNote: Published at 07:48 Beijing time on November 14, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Kiln launches its free Reshaped update
entries.summary: Double Fine has released Kiln: Reshaped, a major free update that adds a new competitive mode as well as local multiplayer and offline play.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report identifies the developer, update, new mode, and local/offline support.
entries.timeNote: Published at 13:24 Beijing time on November 13, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Euro Truck Simulator 2 launches its Coaches DLC
entries.summary: SCS Software has released the Coaches DLC for Euro Truck Simulator 2 on PC, adding passenger transport and three real-world coach models alongside the base game’s freight work.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report confirms the PC launch, SCS Software, and three licensed coach models.
entries.timeNote: Published at 14:10 Beijing time on November 13, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: ワロタ、俺の家のとなり魔王城www enters Steam Early Access
entries.summary: One or Eight and Team EARTHWARS have launched ワロタ、俺の家のとなり魔王城www in Steam Early Access, a rebuilding game set in another world with a demon castle next door.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report confirms the developers, Steam Early Access release, and core premise; no English title is invented.
entries.timeNote: Published at 13:54 Beijing time on November 13, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Hand-drawn survival horror game 迷家 mygohome launches on Steam
entries.summary: bottlecloud has released 迷家 mygohome on Steam. The hand-drawn, top-down survival horror game asks players to explore an unfamiliar room, avoid danger, and survive the night.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report confirms the developer, Steam launch, perspective, art style, and survival-horror premise.
entries.timeNote: Published at 14:33 Beijing time on November 13, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: The Game Awards 2026 nominees will be revealed at 02:00 Beijing time on November 18
entries.summary: The Game Awards 2026 nomination special will stream at 02:00 Beijing time on November 18. The ceremony is scheduled for 09:30 Beijing time on December 11 at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles.
entries.verification: The opened Denfaminicogamer report embeds the official announcement and states both the nomination reveal and ceremony schedule.
entries.timeNote: Published at 07:57 Beijing time on November 14, inside the fixed window; event times are stated in Beijing time.

entries.headline: Girls und Panzer: All-Star Tank Carnival launches March 25, 2027
entries.summary: D3 Publisher says Girls und Panzer: All-Star Tank Carnival will launch for PS5, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC on March 25, 2027, with cross-play across all three platforms and online matches for up to 10 players.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report identifies the publisher announcement, date, platforms, cross-play, and player limit.
entries.timeNote: Published at 11:03 Beijing time on November 13, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Ocarina of Time remake speedrunners find a route that skips the ocarina
entries.summary: A newly found Forest Temple clip in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake can bypass Song of Time obstacles, making it possible to skip the Ocarina of Time and earlier Spiritual Stone collection. Speedrun rules are still being organized.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report describes the sequence break and its routing impact without claiming a final record.
entries.timeNote: Published at 17:44 Beijing time on November 13, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Palworld Official Card Game shipments top 11 million packs
entries.summary: Bushiroad says the first two Palworld Official Card Game booster sets had shipped more than 11 million packs worldwide by early November, while trial events had drawn 24,123 participants. The company cited the English edition’s overseas growth when raising its FY2027 outlook.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report relays Bushiroad’s quarterly results, shipment figures, event participation, overseas sales, and revised forecast.
entries.timeNote: Published at 11:32 Beijing time on November 13, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Grand Theft Auto VI includes an in-game animated series
entries.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI includes Macca & Friends, an animated series shown through the in-game Weazel network. Its first teaser follows Macca the alligator and his wetland friends across Leonida.
entries.verification: The opened IGN report supports the series title, in-game network, and premise; unrelated cost and staffing speculation is not used.
entries.timeNote: Published at 23:11 Beijing time on November 13, inside the fixed window.
